title: Spec 0007: review
description: Review all changes introduced by spec 0007 across CookbookCore and CookbookApp. Verify: correctness and safety of `updateItem` and `appendItem(_:toAisle:)` mutations (edge cases: empty file, no trailing newline, out-of-bounds lineIndex); security-scoped resource access correctly bracketed in every `ShoppingListFiles` code path; `AisleCatalog` is the sole parse point for `aisle.conf` with no duplicate parsing in the view layer; all icons are SF Symbols with no custom assets; accessibility labels present on all icon-only interactive controls (FAB, toolbar +, toolbar ⋯, checkbox, swipe actions, drag handle); no folder icon or ⋯ toolbar on the list view; drag handle is non-interactive; `xcodebuild test` passes; spec is in `specs/done/`.
acceptance_criteria: No custom image assets used — all icons are SF Symbols
Security-scoped resource access correctly bracketed in all ShoppingListFiles I/O paths
AisleCatalog is the only place `AisleConfigParser` is called in the app layer
Accessibility labels present on FAB, toolbar +, toolbar ⋯, item checkbox, delete swipe action, edit swipe action, and drag handle
ShoppingListsView has no folder icon or ellipsis toolbar item
Drag handle (`line.3.horizontal`) has no attached gesture and is explicitly non-interactive
`updateItem` and `appendItem(_:toAisle:)` handle edge cases: empty text, no trailing newline, out-of-bounds index
`xcodebuild test` passes with all new tests included
